conversation.user: I'm in Seattle. Will the city approve my hempcrete walls under Appendix BL?
conversation.assistant:
Yes, Seattle can approve your hemp-lime build using the 2024 International Residential Code (IRC) Appendix BL, which officially standardizes hemp-lime construction at the national level. To make this smooth for your local building department, keep in mind that hempcrete acts as a non-load-bearing insulation infill, meaning a conventional timber frame carries your structural loads. Also, rest assured that hempcrete materials are 100% legal, 0% THC, fire-resistant, and completely unrelated to recreational marijuana.
